<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Cheska Bennett. Member of the proud Guild of Navigators, and recently made captain of The Eternal.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|— ''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 8}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Cheska Bennett Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Cheska Bennett is the Head of the [[Navigator’s Guild]] and the captain of the ship known as [[The Eternal]]. A prominent figure within the various guilds, she is recognized as a [[Soulbound]], possessing a deep connection to her vessel. Known for her tendency toward exaggeration and a cocky, whirlwind-like personality, she often prefers the life of the sea to time spent in an office. Her personal style is frequently informal, often involving patched clothing and large hats or bandanas, though she has been seen in more formal attire for specific occasions. Throughout her career, Bennett has demonstrated significant leadership and combat skills, including proficiency in fencing. She is a well-connected and wealthy individual with an extensive collection of maritime treasures. In times of crisis, she has been known to take decisive action, such as mobilizing the [[Navigator’s Guild|Navigator's Guild]] for military support or leading attacks herself. Despite her bravado, she has faced significant hardships, including the loss of crew members and damage to her ship during encounters with [[Elderspawn]]. She has also sustained injuries in combat, including the loss of an eye.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Cheska has [[Izyrian]] red hair that is tied back with a bandana. She wears a wide hat and a blue suit featuring gold trim, and she has one eye covered by a ragged black eyepatch.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a leader who puts her people first, Cheska is a decisive figure who has predicted the involvement of others. She shows disdain for the [[Elders]] and maintains a strategic outlook, even pretending certain fleet movements were planned in anticipation of a crisis.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Cheska is an adversary to [[Nathanael Bareius|Bareius]] and is the target of a duel sought by [[Calder]]. She also provided information and estimates to [[Calder]] regarding [[Tommison|Captain Tommison]] and the ship [[The Reliable]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Cheska is a [[Navigator]] who is [[Soulbound]] to her ship, [[The Eternal]]. In combat or command, she utilizes a curved saber and a [[Calder's captain’s horn|captain's horn]].}}
